mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.dept_id AS deptId, c.dept_name AS deptName, c.subject, c.content,
c.started_at AS `start`, c.ended_at AS `end`, c.type FROM calendar_view c WHERE c.type = 2 OR (c.type = 1 AND c.dept_id = (SELECT u.dept_tbl_id FROM user_tbl u WHERE u.id = #{userId})) OR (c.type = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_tbl (user_tbl_id, subject, content, started_at, ended_at, type) VALUES (#{event.userId}, #{event.subject}, #{event.content}, #{event.start}, #{event.end}, #{event.type})
